metadata.article_title: Commission or request to examine witness not within India.

article.title: Commission or request to examine witness not within India.
article.content:
5Commission or request to examine witness not within India.

Order 26, Rule 5
Where any Court to which application is made for the issue of a commission for the examination of a person residing at any place not within 4[India] is satisfied that the evidence of such person is necessary, the Court may issue such commission or a letter of request.

4 Subs. by Act 2 of 1951, s. 3, for “the States”.
